title: 焚化底渣金屬回收~Metal recovery from incinerator bottom ash
focus: 以粒徑、解離度和品位回收率設計底渣金屬分選的教學流程~Build a bottom-ash metal-separation workflow around size, liberation and grade-recovery evidence
summary: 本課以「以粒徑、解離度和品位回收率設計底渣金屬分選的教學流程」為主軸，依序處理底渣批次與金屬基準、鐵磁性金屬回收、含水與細泥附著、礦物產物浸出評估、分選用電與資源效益。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Build a bottom-ash metal-separation workflow around size, liberation and grade-recovery evidence, progressing through Bottom-ash batches and metal basis, Ferromagnetic metal recovery, Moisture and adhering fines, Leaching of mineral products, Separation electricity and resource benefit. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

歐盟廢棄物焚化技術參考入口

units.title: 底渣批次與金屬基準~Bottom-ash batches and metal basis
units.mechanism: 先確認底渣來源與乾濕基，區分爐底渣、飛灰和其他混入物流。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。~Identify the bottom-ash source and moisture basis, distinguishing it from fly ash and other mixed streams. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.
units.verify: 針對「底渣批次與金屬基準」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Bottom-ash batches and metal basis, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「底渣批次與金屬基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Bottom-ash batches and metal basis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 相同百分比不論濕基或乾基都代表相同質量。~The same percentage gives the same mass on wet and dry bases.
units.practice: 只將 f 改成 0.22，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 180 變成 220 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only f to 0.22, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 180 to 220 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 粒徑分級與篩分~Size classes and screening
units.mechanism: 不同粒徑的解離程度和適用分選機不同，先分級再比較效率。 粒徑分級先改變後續處理對象；篩孔名目尺寸不等於每顆粒都能通過的保證。~Particle sizes differ in liberation and suitable separators; classify before comparing performance. Size classification changes the downstream feed; nominal aperture is not a guarantee that every smaller particle passes.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；細粒比例 f=0.30；細粒捕集率 r=0.90。公式 mf=m*f*r，計算得 270 kg。適用邊界：只算細粒回收，不含粗粒誤入及顆粒團聚。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; fines fraction f=0.30; fines capture r=0.90. Formula mf=m*f*r gives 270 kg. Applicability: Fines recovery only; coarse misplacement and agglomeration are omitted.
units.verify: 針對「粒徑分級與篩分」，分別量進料與兩出口的粒徑分布，檢查堵孔、含水與旁通。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Size classes and screening, Measure feed and both outlet size distributions, checking blinded apertures, moisture and bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 濕料結團讓可回收細粒留在粗料中。 在「粒徑分級與篩分」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Wet agglomeration retains recoverable fines in the coarse stream. Mark where this error can enter the Size classes and screening flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 篩孔大小可以完全決定所有顆粒的分離結果。~Aperture size completely determines the separation of every particle.
units.practice: 只將 r 改成 0.70，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 270 變成 210 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only capture r to 0.70, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 270 to 210 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 鐵磁性金屬回收~Ferromagnetic metal recovery
units.mechanism: 磁選以鐵磁性響應分離，夾附礦物和纏繞金屬會改變產品重量。 回收率衡量原料目標物有多少進入產品；純度則看產品中有多少是目標物，兩者不同。~Magnetic separation uses ferromagnetic response; adhering minerals and tangled metal change product mass. Recovery measures how much feed target reaches product; purity measures target fraction within product. They differ.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；目標金屬分率 x=0.08；分選回收率 r=0.75。公式 m_metal=m*x*r，計算得 60 kg。適用邊界：已知原料成分、單一分選步驟；未計附著物或後續精製。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; target metal fraction x=0.08; separation recovery r=0.75. Formula m_metal=m*x*r gives 60 kg. Applicability: Known feed composition and one separator; adhering material and downstream refining are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「鐵磁性金屬回收」，對進料、產品及尾料分別秤重化驗，求回收率與純度並關閉金屬收支。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Ferromagnetic metal recovery, Weigh and assay feed, product and tailings; calculate recovery and purity and close the metal balance. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 提高產品總重量可能只是混入更多非金屬。 在「鐵磁性金屬回收」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A heavier product may merely contain more non-metal contamination. Mark where this error can enter the Ferromagnetic metal recovery flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 產品越重就代表金屬回收率與純度都越高。~A heavier product always means both greater metal recovery and purity.
units.practice: 只將 r 改成 0.85，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變成 68 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only recovery r to 0.85, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 60 to 68 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 非鐵金屬渦電流分選~Nonferrous eddy-current separation
units.mechanism: 導電性、尺寸與形狀影響拋射路徑，不能把所有非鐵金屬看作同一粒子。 純度是產品內的目標質量比例；回收率高仍可能因夾帶而純度低。~Conductivity, size and shape affect trajectories; nonferrous particles are not interchangeable. Purity is target mass fraction within product; high recovery can coexist with low purity because of entrainment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：產品總質量 mp=80 kg；其中目標物 mt=60 kg。公式 purity=mt/mp*100，計算得 75 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、代表性樣本；未把化學品位與產品規格混為一談。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total product mp=80 kg; target material mt=60 kg. Formula purity=mt/mp*100 gives 75 %. Applicability: Same wet/dry basis and representative sample; assay is not a complete product specification.
units.verify: 針對「非鐵金屬渦電流分選」，用產品分樣和尾料分析建立品位—回收率曲線，而非只報單一指標。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Nonferrous eddy-current separation, Build grade-recovery curves from product subsamples and tail assays rather than reporting one metric. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 夾帶濕泥或礦物使重量看似增加，卻降低可售品質。 在「非鐵金屬渦電流分選」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Entrained wet fines or minerals increase apparent mass while reducing product quality. Mark where this error can enter the Nonferrous eddy-current separation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要金屬回收率高，產品純度必定也高。~High metal recovery necessarily implies high product purity.
units.practice: 只將非目標物增加 10 kg，mt 不變，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 75 變成 66.6667 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Add only 10 kg non-target material, holding mt fixed, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 75 to 66.6667 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 含水與細泥附著~Moisture and adhering fines
units.mechanism: 表面水與細泥增加黏附，影響篩分和金屬品位；乾濕處理流程需用同基準比較。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。~Surface water and fines promote adhesion, affecting screening and grade; compare wet and dry routes on consistent bases. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
units.verify: 針對「含水與細泥附著」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Moisture and adhering fines, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「含水與細泥附著」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and adhering fines flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 濕樣減重多少就代表固體或污染物被去除多少。~Wet-mass reduction equals the mass of solids or contaminants removed.
units.practice: 只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only wet-basis moisture w to 0.40, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 700 to 600 kg dry solids. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 細粒金屬損失~Fine-metal losses
units.mechanism: 粗粒回收率高仍可能漏掉細粒金屬，應為每個粒級建立獨立收支。 回收率衡量原料目標物有多少進入產品；純度則看產品中有多少是目標物，兩者不同。~High coarse recovery may hide fine-metal losses; construct separate balances by size class. Recovery measures how much feed target reaches product; purity measures target fraction within product. They differ.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；目標金屬分率 x=0.08；分選回收率 r=0.75。公式 m_metal=m*x*r，計算得 60 kg。適用邊界：已知原料成分、單一分選步驟；未計附著物或後續精製。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; target metal fraction x=0.08; separation recovery r=0.75. Formula m_metal=m*x*r gives 60 kg. Applicability: Known feed composition and one separator; adhering material and downstream refining are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「細粒金屬損失」，對進料、產品及尾料分別秤重化驗，求回收率與純度並關閉金屬收支。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Fine-metal losses, Weigh and assay feed, product and tailings; calculate recovery and purity and close the metal balance. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 提高產品總重量可能只是混入更多非金屬。 在「細粒金屬損失」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A heavier product may merely contain more non-metal contamination. Mark where this error can enter the Fine-metal losses flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 產品越重就代表金屬回收率與純度都越高。~A heavier product always means both greater metal recovery and purity.
units.practice: 只將 r 改成 0.85，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變成 68 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only recovery r to 0.85, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 60 to 68 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 礦物產物浸出評估~Leaching of mineral products
units.mechanism: 金屬回收後的礦物料仍需確認環境適用性；外觀乾淨不是浸出證據。 浸出質量可由液體濃度和體積換算，但不能把此值當成樣品總含量。~The mineral fraction still needs environmental suitability assessment; clean appearance is not leaching evidence. Released mass follows liquid concentration and volume, but is not the specimen total content.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：浸出液濃度 C=2 mg/L；液體體積 V=2 L；試樣乾質量 m=0.10 kg。公式 released=C*V/m，計算得 40 mg/kg dry sample。適用邊界：以單次均勻浸出作教學換算；不同方法的液固比、pH 和時間不可混用。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Leachate concentration C=2 mg/L; liquid volume V=2 L; dry specimen m=0.10 kg. Formula released=C*V/m gives 40 mg/kg dry sample. Applicability: A single homogeneous extraction for teaching conversion; do not mix liquid/solid ratios, pH or duration across methods.
units.verify: 針對「礦物產物浸出評估」，記錄方法、空白、液固比和乾重，將浸出 mg/L 與換算 mg/kg 分欄呈現。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Leaching of mineral products, Record method, blanks, liquid/solid ratio and dry mass; display leachate mg/L separately from converted mg/kg. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 浸出液 mg/L 誤標成固體 mg/kg 會改變結論。 在「礦物產物浸出評估」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Labelling leachate mg/L as solid mg/kg changes the interpretation. Mark where this error can enter the Leaching of mineral products flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 一次浸出試驗能直接得到樣品的所有污染物總含量。~One leaching test directly gives all total contaminant content.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 3 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 60 mg/kg dry sample。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only C to 3 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 60 mg/kg dry sample. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 粉塵捕集與外逸~Dust collection and escape
units.mechanism: 乾式分選的粉塵負荷應沿各轉運點追蹤，末端濃度要連同氣量解讀。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Track dry-separation dust at transfer points and interpret outlet concentrations with gas flow. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「粉塵捕集與外逸」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Dust collection and escape, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「粉塵捕集與外逸」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Dust collection and escape flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 分選用電與資源效益~Separation electricity and resource benefit
units.mechanism: 更精細分選增加回收也增加能耗，按每噸進料與產品品質比較情境。 活動量乘排放係數給指定邊界的影響，係數需匹配地區、年度與電力方法。~Finer separation increases recovery and energy demand; compare scenarios per tonne of feed and by product quality. Activity multiplied by a factor gives impact for a specified boundary; factors must match region, year and electricity-accounting method.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：用電 E=200 kWh/t；假設電力排放係數 f=0.4 kg CO₂e/kWh。公式 impact=E*f，計算得 80 kg CO₂e/t。適用邊界：f 是教學假設而非任何國家即時係數；只含用電項。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Electricity E=200 kWh/t; assumed grid factor f=0.4 kg CO₂e/kWh. Formula impact=E*f gives 80 kg CO₂e/t. Applicability: f is a teaching assumption, not a current national factor; only electricity is included.
units.verify: 針對「分選用電與資源效益」，保存電表邊界、產量與係數版本，對替代電力情境作敏感度分析。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Separation electricity and resource benefit, Record metering boundary, output and factor version; test alternative electricity scenarios. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把不同年份或系統邊界的係數混用會產生假比較。 在「分選用電與資源效益」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Mixing factors across years or boundaries creates misleading comparisons. Mark where this error can enter the Separation electricity and resource benefit flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 同樣 kWh 用電量在世界任何地方都有相同碳排。~Equal kWh causes identical carbon emissions everywhere.
units.practice: 只將 f 改成 0.2 kg CO₂e/kWh，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 40 kg CO₂e/t。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only grid factor f to 0.2 kg CO₂e/kWh, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 40 kg CO₂e/t. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 品位回收率交接~Grade-recovery handoff
units.mechanism: 交付進料、產品、尾料的乾重與化驗，指出最影響金屬閉合的不確定項。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Deliver dry masses and assays for feed, product and tailings and identify the dominant metal-balance uncertainty. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「品位回收率交接」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Grade-recovery handoff, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「品位回收率交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Grade-recovery handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
